elly: Heads-up — trying to cut a patch publish for the sample SDK, CI failed on the regen checksum step. anyone seen a checksum/sort-order flake like this?
ben: saw that earlier, looks like hash mismatch from typegen. CI log says different ordering in generated enums.
chris: could be a nondet map iteration in the generator code. we had one bug where Object.keys() wasn't sorted before generation.
elly: local `yarn run gen` produces a different checksum than CI expects. snippet:
```
ci-bot: job 7123 - gen-validate failed
Error: checksum mismatch for lib/generated/types.ts
Expected: 7aa9f4d
Found: 4d2c1b8
```
ben: quick unblock: regen locally, commit the generated file and bump patch semver, then rerun the pipeline. longer term we should make the generator canonical (sort keys + stable type ordering) and add a pre-commit or pre-merge check.
chris: agree. also add a CI step that runs regen in a clean container (no cache restore) so we replicate fresh runs. that would catch cache-driven diffs.
elly: pushing a regen commit now with node/npm versions in the message for traceability. will open a follow-up ticket to make the generator deterministic.
release-bot: published sample-sdk v0.8.7 at 1771234582
ben: thanks, can we add the regen command to the release checklist? this is costing time.
ellY: yup — creating a small PR to add `yarn gen --verify` to pre-merge checks and updating the release playbook.
chris: created ticket DEVEX-882: deterministic-typegen + pre-merge verify. Assigning to eng-tooling.
elly: thanks folks :thumbsup:
